title: Portfolio Balance Signer
description: An asset management firm needs to assign either a positive or negative coefficient to each financial holding in an array to achieve a precise target net portfolio value. Given an array of integer asset prices and a target integer value, write a function to return the total number of distinct ways to assign signs (+ or -) to the elements such that their evaluated sum equals the target value.
input_format: An array of integers 'prices' and an integer 'target'
output_format: An integer representing the count of valid sign assignments

examples.explanation: There are 5 ways to assign signs to make the sum equal to 3: -1+1+1+1+1 = 3, +1-1+1+1+1 = 3, etc.
